about_section_title: Center for Placement of Elderly and Disabled Persons from Cocieri municipality
about_text_1: The Center is a social institution, with legal entity status, founded by the Ministry of Labor and Social Protection (hereinafter MLSP) and managed by the Agency for Managing High-Specialized Social Services (hereinafter AMHSSS). The Center is a social institution of public interest, provider of high-specialized social services for temporary placement, long-term and emergency placement. Services are provided free of charge or for a fee. The cost of providing paid services within the Center is approved by the founder.
about_text_2: The Center's mission consists in providing assistance and complex interventions that may include any combination of specialized social services, provided to beneficiaries with increased dependency (people with intellectual, psychosocial disabilities and age limit) who require continuous supervision (24/24 hours) to maintain/improve quality of life.
about_text_3: Beneficiaries of the Center are people who have reached the age of 18, people with disabilities or people with age limit, are citizens of the Republic of Moldova or foreigners (specified in art. 2, para. (1) of Law no. 274/2011 on the integration of foreigners in the Republic of Moldova).

faq_what_is_CPPVPD_q: What is the Center for Placement of Elderly and Disabled Persons?
faq_what_is_CPPVPD_a: The Center for Placement of Elderly and Disabled Persons from Cocieri municipality is a public social assistance institution that provides specialized services for young beneficiaries (0-7 years) at risk or with special needs. The center operates under the Agency for Social Services and Inclusion and has as its mission the protection, care and rehabilitation of vulnerable beneficiaries.
faq_what_services_q: What services does the center offer?
faq_what_services_a: The center offers multiple specialized services: Crisis and Family Reintegration Section for beneficiaries in emergency situations, Maternal Section for mothers and children in difficulty, Day Section for children with neuro-motor disabilities, Respite Section for families with children with special needs, Psycho-pedagogical Assistance Section, Rehabilitation Section and Medical Assistance Section.
faq_how_to_apply_q: How can I request the center's services?
faq_how_to_apply_a: To request the center's services, you must contact the Child Protection Directorate in Cocieri municipality or the local guardianship and trusteeship authorities. They will assess the situation and issue, if necessary, a placement order. You can also contact the center directly at phone number 022 737 027 for consultations.
faq_emergency_contact_q: What number can I call in case of emergency?
faq_emergency_contact_a: In case of emergency, you can call phone number 022 737 027, which operates 24/7. The center has a non-stop operating regime for crisis situations. You can also contact the Emergency Service for Child Protection or the competent local authorities.
